questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: From 00:08 to 00:12, the board is fully visible and holds exactly three pens arranged in a row.
While the caps are all at the bottom, the third pen (rightmost) is rotated diagonally while the first two are vertical, meaning they are not aligned identically in direction.
All three pens have translucent barrels and black caps; no color mismatch is visible.
All three pens appear to have their black caps on; no bare writing tips are exposed, and lengths appear similar.
The board moves continuously from left to right throughout the clip without stopping or reversing.
The pens remain fixed in their relative positions on the board as it slides; they do not shift or slide independently.

parsed.reason: The third pen is oriented diagonally while the other two are vertical, violating the condition that all pens must be aligned the same direction.

description: One pen is flipped relative to the others (variant).
